body: By default we're freezing the prototype. You can set tauri.conf.json > security > freezePrototype to false to fix this problem. Note that you should freeze the prototype later if possible. Documentation on this will be updated soon.
We're going to publish a new release changing the default value to false since this breaks on several frameworks.
